title: A transcriptomic atlas of acute stress response to low pH in multiple Issatchenkia orientalis strains
summary: A transcriptomic atlas of the low-pH stress response across multiple strains of the acid-tolerant yeast Issatchenkia orientalis, a chassis for industrial organic acid production.
authors: Veronika Dubinkina; Shreyas Bhogale; Po-Hsien Hsieh; Pouya Dibaeinia; Ananthan Nambiar; Sergei Maslov; Yuseok Yoshikuni; Saurabh Sinha
